The ENT Companion 2.0 uses a new Android signing key and installs alongside the previous version. In the old app, open **More → Back up my progress**. Then install **ENT-Companion.apk** and open **More → Restore a backup** in the new app. Check your progress before removing the old app.

The public edition ships study notes, original diagrams, and credited surgical photographs. On the web, open **More → Offline downloads** to save individual study collections. The web archive contains the static site ready to deploy.
